prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
context: Rather than entering new territories, the group spent two years ____ its position in the markets it had already won, deepening relationships with existing distributors.
explanation: 「鞏固既有地位」是 consolidate 的固定搭配（consolidate one's position / lead），受詞是抽象的優勢而非實體單位；句首 Rather than entering new territories 指明公司不再擴張、只求穩住既有成果，正是這個語意。

distractorExplanations.a: merge 要求「兩個對等的實體合而為一」（merge A with B），受詞不能是 position；要說 merged its European units 才通。
distractorExplanations.b: centralize 指把分散的職能集中到單一中心，受詞是 operations、decision-making 這類事務，不與 position 搭配。
distractorExplanations.d: unify 指把分裂的多方統合為一體，句中只有一個主體、沒有多方可統合，論元不足。

prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
context: The clause is ____: it can be read either as requiring an annual review or as merely permitting one, and each reading imposes different duties.
explanation: ambiguous 的定義是「同一段文字有兩種以上都說得通的解讀」，冒號後正好列出兩種互相衝突的讀法；它的主語限定為訊息本身（條文、規格、答覆），不能是人的心理狀態。

distractorExplanations.a: vague 是「講得不夠具體、缺乏細節」，若條文根本沒交代才用；此處兩種讀法都很明確，只是彼此衝突。
distractorExplanations.c: obscure 指艱澀難懂、不易看出意思，重點在理解困難，而非同時存在多種解讀。
distractorExplanations.d: indecisive 的主語必須是人，形容「拿不定主意」，不能用來描述條文。

prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
context: Exponential backoff cannot stop transient failures from occurring, but it does ____ their impact, keeping latency within agreed limits rather than removing the spikes altogether.
explanation: mitigate 指「把已經存在的負面影響減輕，但不根除」，受詞必須是負面的事物（impact、risk、damage）；句尾 rather than removing the spikes altogether 明確排除了「完全消除」的選項。

distractorExplanations.b: eliminate 是「完全消除」，與句尾「並未徹底去除尖峰」直接矛盾。
distractorExplanations.c: eradicate 語氣更強，指連根拔除（多用於疾病、弊端），同樣與「未根除」衝突。
distractorExplanations.d: nullify 指使某物完全失效、歸零，程度上等同消除，且多用於法律效力（nullify a contract）。

options.text: The confidentiality agreement precludes the team to publish the raw data.
The confidentiality agreement precludes that the team publishes the raw data.
The confidentiality agreement precludes the team from publishing the raw data.
The confidentiality agreement precludes the team against publishing the raw data.

explanation: preclude 的論元結構是 preclude somebody from doing something：受事者直接接在動詞後，被禁止的行為以 from + 動名詞帶出，這是唯一標準的句型。

distractorExplanations.a: preclude 不接不定詞；接不定詞的是 allow、enable、permit 這類動詞，此處必須改成 from publishing。
distractorExplanations.b: preclude 不接 that 子句；若要用子句得改寫成 makes it impossible for the team to publish。
distractorExplanations.d: against 不與 preclude 搭配；搭配 against 的是 warn、advise、guard 這類動詞。

prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
context: With no capital of its own, the start-up had to ____ its loyal user base to win favourable terms from the distributors it approached.
explanation: 空格後面直接接受詞，四個選項中只有 leverage 是及物動詞（leverage something to do something），其餘三個都必須先補上介系詞才能帶受詞。

distractorExplanations.a: capitalize 此義固定用 capitalize on something，少了 on 就不合語法。
distractorExplanations.c: 此義的 draw 必須說 draw on something（借助既有資源），不能直接接受詞。
distractorExplanations.d: profit 是不及物動詞，要說 profit from something。

prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
context: Several members sensed that the proposal was flawed, yet nobody could ____ the objection precisely enough for the committee to act on it.
explanation: articulate 指「把心裡模糊的想法轉換成清楚的語言」，受詞是想法、理由、反對意見這類抽象內容，struggle / fail to articulate 是最典型的搭配。

distractorExplanations.a: enunciate 指把字音發得清楚，關心的是發音品質而非內容是否說得明白。
distractorExplanations.b: narrate 的受詞必須是有先後情節的事件或故事，不能是一項反對意見。
distractorExplanations.c: pronounce 若不是指發音，就是「正式宣告」（pronounce it invalid），語域與論元都不合。

options.text: He was extremely respective towards the senior researchers during the review.
Please forward the complaint to the respective department head for a decision.
The two figures rose by four and nine per cent respective last quarter.
The two authors returned to their respective universities once the conference ended.

explanation: respective 只能放在複數名詞前，而且前文必須已經出現多個對象，讀者才知道「各自」分別對應誰；the two authors → their respective universities 正是這個配對結構。

distractorExplanations.a: 形容態度恭敬要用 respectful towards；respective 與禮貌毫無關聯。
distractorExplanations.b: 只有單一對象時不能用 respective，應改為 the appropriate department head。
distractorExplanations.c: 句末標示兩組數字的對應順序要用副詞 respectively，不能用形容詞 respective。

prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
context: Across a million iterations the two implementations differ by under three milliseconds, so the performance gap is ____ for any workload we actually run.
explanation: negligible 形容「數量小到可以直接忽略」，主語限定為可量化的差距、成本或風險，正好承接前面三毫秒的數據。

distractorExplanations.b: negligent 形容人未盡應盡的注意義務（法律上的過失），主語必須是人或機構。
distractorExplanations.c: neglectful 指疏於照顧、對責任置之不理，主語同樣限於人，且常搭配 of。
distractorExplanations.d: negotiable 指「還有商量餘地的」，用於價格或條件，與數量大小無關。

prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
context: The reviewer objects that the paper repeatedly ____ correlation with causation, collapsing two distinct claims into one and drawing conclusions the data cannot support.
explanation: conflate A with B 專指「錯誤地把兩個本該分開的概念當成同一件事」，字義本身帶有批評語氣，與 collapsing two distinct claims into one 完全吻合。

distractorExplanations.a: consolidate 是刻意而且正面的整合（把資源併得更精簡），不用於概念上的混淆，也不搭配 with 表示「與……混為一談」。
distractorExplanations.c: reconcile A with B 指化解兩者之間的矛盾使其並存，前提是兩者都保留下來，而不是被壓成一個。
distractorExplanations.d: associate A with B 只說明兩者有關聯，並未指控作者把它們當成同一件事，力道不足以支撐 collapsing into one。

options.text: The review of those accounts was subsequent, so the committee took no action.
Subsequent of the incident, the company rewrote its entire reporting policy.
Subsequent audits of the same accounts uncovered no further irregularities at all.
The company subsequent its annual audit by three months without telling anyone.

explanation: subsequent 幾乎只能放在名詞前面當限定語（subsequent audits / versions / requests），用來標示時間順序上「後來的」那些事物。

distractorExplanations.a: subsequent 不單獨用在 be 動詞之後；要表達「這是後來才做的」應說 came later 或 was carried out later。
distractorExplanations.b: 正式片語是 subsequent to + 名詞，不是 subsequent of；一般寫作直接用 After the incident 更自然。
distractorExplanations.d: subsequent 是形容詞，沒有動詞用法；延後要用 postponed 或 deferred。

prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
context: After the irregularities came to light, the firm's procurement practices came under intense ____ from regulators and from the financial press alike.
explanation: come under scrutiny 是固定搭配，scrutiny 又是不可數名詞，可以直接被 intense、close、public 等形容詞修飾，施力者正是監理機關與媒體這類「審視者」。

distractorExplanations.a: examination 在此語境多半可數（an examination of the accounts），而且不與 come under 搭配。
distractorExplanations.b: inspection 指依規定實地查驗，由檢查人員執行（carry out an inspection），媒體不會 inspect 一家公司的採購流程。
distractorExplanations.c: surveillance 指長時間的暗中監視，語域偏安全與情報，不用於公開的輿論與監理檢視。

prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
context: The task force was ____ set up to review safety procedures, though its own members later conceded that its real purpose was to defend decisions already taken.
explanation: ostensibly 專門用來標示「這是對外宣稱的理由，實情可能並非如此」，後半句 its real purpose 隨即揭穿表面說法，正是這個副詞存在的理由。

distractorExplanations.b: evidently 表示「從跡象看來確實如此」，等於肯定表面說法為真，與後半句的轉折互相矛盾。
distractorExplanations.c: undeniably 語氣最強，表示無可否認，用了它就不可能再說真正目的另有其他。
distractorExplanations.d: conclusively 修飾的是 prove、show、demonstrate 這類動詞，不能用來修飾成立機構的理由。

options.text: A degree of rounding error is inherent of any floating-point calculation.
A degree of rounding error is inherent in any floating-point calculation.
The new owners inherent a great deal of technical debt from the old team.
We added an inherent validation step to the pipeline earlier this quarter.

explanation: inherent 只搭配介系詞 in 或 to（inherent in / inherent to），表示某性質天生就內建在該事物之中、無法移除。

distractorExplanations.a: inherent 不搭配 of，這是最常見的介系詞誤用；正確說法是 inherent in any floating-point calculation。
distractorExplanations.c: 「承接、繼承」是動詞 inherit，與形容詞 inherent 拼字相近，但詞性與意思都不同。
distractorExplanations.d: 後來加上去的檢查步驟依定義就不是「本來就存在」的，inherent 與 added 語意互相牴觸。

options.text: The gateway validates about each request before passing it to the payment service.
The gateway validates each request to be signed before passing it to the service.
The gateway validates each request against the published schema before passing it on.
The gateway validates the published schema against each request before passing it on.

explanation: validate 是及物動詞，直接接受詞；要指明「依照哪一套標準檢查」時用 validate + 受詞 + against + 標準，被檢查的資料放在動詞後，標準放在 against 之後。

distractorExplanations.a: validate 後面不加 about，介系詞會切斷動詞與受詞的連結，應直接說 validates each request。
distractorExplanations.b: validate 不接 to be / to V 的補語；要交代檢查的內容應改用 validates that each request is signed。
distractorExplanations.d: against 之後放的必須是標準（schema），被檢查的對象放在動詞後；此句把兩者的方向顛倒了。
